articles.title: Bitcoin plunges below $59,000 as rush to cash puts new bear market lows back in play
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is closing in on its $57,700 summer low as Delphi Digital strategist warns the Fed could make matters worse and STS Digital sees cash as the place to hide.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
articles.snippet: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

articles.title: SEC charges 8 firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
articles.snippet: The SEC says the operators showed investors fake certificates and pointed them to filings on the agency’s website as proof of regulatory approval.

articles.title: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading
articles.snippet: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.

articles.title: Why higher rates could slow Bitcoin buying at treasury firms
articles.snippet: A treasury company can have years of dividends covered and still struggle to sell new shares on terms that make another Bitcoin purchase worthwhile.
